udon_rule: the disc is >= 90 % covered over [U7b, U7b + 1.5] (run 6 table: 0.96 at U7b, 1.00 at U7b + 0.5, 0.93 at U7b + 1.5, 0.89 at U7b + 2.0): START the fade of the skybox moon DISC at U7b + 1.5 and take it out over 2 s (EV-linear), leaving the halo #5A6A88 (Lanbai/Sky halo term) on: the moon is TAKEN. aureole: Lanbai/Sky moon halo: fill = #8FA3C8 x (1.6 exp(-0.9 a) + 0.06 exp(-0.32 a)), a = angle from the disc centre in degrees (L* ~55 at 1 deg, the band by ~8 deg); LanbaiFog adds 0.35 x the same term
